description: `prose --output json list` prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope whose suggestedArgv is `cli run list`.

problem.action: Use `cli run list`: `prose --output json cli run list`.

details.reason: `list` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli run list`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
